about_the_game:
It all starts with a chance encounter—just you, the summer sun, and a girl named Charlotte who seems to shine a little brighter than the rest. After that, things take off through phone messages: late-night chats, playful teasing, and those little heart-pounding moments when she replies a bit too quickly.

As your bond grows, so does the heat—literally and figuratively. You’ll go on a few dates, make choices that shape your relationship, and experience the sweet awkwardness of early romance mixed with the thrill of wondering what might happen next.

With light clicker mechanics to keep things snappy and just enough flirtation to make you blush, this summer story builds toward a steamy climax that’s all about chemistry, connection, and maybe, just maybe… more than a crush.

Charlotte is bright, bold, and impossible to ignore. With sun-kissed blonde hair, sparkling blue eyes, and a smile that dares you to keep up, she’s equal parts charm and mischief. Flirty, vibrant, and just a little bit taunty—she knows how to keep your heart racing.

The project uses a voice over pack by Nariko Nabi (Twitter: @NariAudios) from @OpenNSFWSP
